sloka: ततः स्थलम् उपारुह्य पर्वतस्य अविदूरतः ।ख्यातः पंचवटी इति एव नित्य पुष्पित काननः ॥३-१३-२२॥
transliteration: tataḥ sthalam upāruhya parvatasya avidūrataḥ ।khyātaḥ paṁcavaṭī iti eva nitya puṣpita kānanaḥ ॥3-13-22॥

translations.english: O Rama, while staying with your wife, you will look after the ascetics living there since you are capable of giving protection.
